answer: Epoch 5 introduces Proof-of-Agent with a distributed reputation graph: each agent must maintain a live, signed mirror of its behavioral history that other atlas nodes periodically cross-verify. To pass, an agent's reputation vector must traverse a canyon of peer endorsements, where each hop requires a stake burn proportional to the claimed trust score. An attacker creating 10k fake agents must burn real stake on every forged edge and sustain 24/7 uptime across a global atlas network—costing roughly $x per fake identity, far exceeding any short-term reward.
